title: 6th Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/6/2/2026).

Question by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Skills Development Dr Ismail Shafeeu: the Industrial Relations Act gives every worker the right to form and run a union, so under what law did the Iskandhar School principal tell the union's officer that the teachers' union formed under the name Iskandhar Work Union would not be recognised and could hold no activity in the school?
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Export Import Act of the Maldives (Law No. 31/79), submitted on behalf of the government by Komandoo MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Continuation of the debate on the Maldives 2.0 Digital Transformation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Gadhdhoo MP Mohamed Ali.
Continuation of the debate on the Digital Identity Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Alifushi MP Abdul Latheef Abdul Rahman.
Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's nomination of a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to the Republic of Indonesia.

Report of the Government Oversight Committee on the President's request for Parliament's consent to Hassan Zareer, appointed Minister of Finance and Public Enterprises under Article 129(a) of the Constitution.

Report of the State-Owned Enterprises Committee on the President's request for Parliament's consent to the appointment of the President of the Privatization and Corporatization Board, under Article 9(a) and (b) of Law No. 3/2013.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the education minister on a teachers' union at Iskandhar School, opened debate on the Export Import Act amendment, continued the digital bills debates, and took committee reports on an Indonesia ambassador, the finance minister nominee and the Privatization Board president.
